answer.answer: PM SVANidhi offers street vendors a livelihood mechanism through collateral-free working capital loans [E01]. The scheme provides loans of ₹10,000 in the first tranche, with subsequent tranches of ₹20,000 and ₹50,000, along with 7% interest subsidy and digital transaction incentives [E01]. From the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U) addresses housing shortages for eligible urban households [E02]. PMAY-U was launched on 25th June 2015 and provides pucca houses to eligible urban households in the EWS, LIG, and MIG categories through components like the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) [E02].
